newsitem.title: USA: Timken contracts rolling mill component.
newsitem.headline: Timken contracts rolling mill component.

text.p: Timken Co said Monday it awarded two major contracts as part of its $55 million planned investment at the company's Harrison Steel Plant in Canton, Ohio.

Timken said it entered into agreements with Danieli & C. - Officine Meccaniche SpA to build the rolling mill and bar processing equipment and with Reliance Electric, a part of Rockwell International Corp, for the electrical components.
These contracts represent approximately two-thirds of the cost of the project, Timken said.
Danieli, located in Italy, will build the rolling mill including the reheating furnace, associated hardware, handling equipment and size gauging system, the company said.
Reliance Electric, located in Euclid, Ohio, will provide the electrical components including motors, drives and computer automation controls.

It said the new mill and equipment will make the Harrison Steel Plant a premier producer of high-quality steel bars in the 1-7/8-inch to 6-inch range. Construction of the mill is expected to begin during the first quarter of 1997 and it is planned to be fully operational by mid-1998.
